article.title: Black Zombie: Voodoo, colonial consumption, and the monsterization of Haiti
article.author: Sherronda J. Brown
article.content: Black Zombie illustrates how the zombie exploded in Western culture with occultist and explorer William Seabrook's The Magic Island in 1929, a travelogue in which he claims to have seen Haitian zombies working in sugarcane fields. Read more via Scalawag : Black Zombie: Voodoo, colonial consumption, and the monsterization of Haiti .
